Event parameters have naming conventions that must be followed in order to dynamically call web services through actions. The following conventions refer to the PARAMETER_NAME column in the SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT_PARAMETERS table.
Defines the URL for the web service call
<Method>ServiceURL where <Method> is the Http method (GET, POST, DELETE, etc.).
Pull parameter value from detail pane model
Any value from the detail pane model can be passed as an  argument to the web service call

<ParameterType>_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST) and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the
How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Detail Pane Model
Pull parameter value from grid column
Any column from the selected grid row can be passed as an  argument to the web service call

<ParameterType>_Grid_<ControlName>_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST), <ControlName> is the name of the grid control, and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the
How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Grid
Pull parameter value from input prompt
User input via a Modal Dialog prompt can be passed as an argument to the web service call

<ParameterType>_Input_<ControlName>_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST), <ControlName> is the name of the input control, and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the
How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from an Input Control
Pull parameter value from javascript function
The return value from a javascript function can be passed as an argument to the web service call

<ParameterType>_Function_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST) and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the
How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from a JavaScript Function Call
The default success callback when the web service completes can be overridden
<Method>_SuccessCallback where <Method> is the Http method (GET, POST, DELETE, etc.). Please reference the
How to: Override the Default Success Callback
Enable or disable an action based on the data in the selected grid record
EnableAction_<ControlName> where <ControlName> is the name of the control tied to the action.

        Screen Control Event Parameter Naming Conventions
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
User Interface Extensibility
 > Metadata Web Pages
 > Shared
 > Screen Control Event Parameter Naming Conventions
    
    
    
        Event parameters have naming conventions that must be followed in order to dynamically call web services through actions. The following conventions refer to the PARAMETER_NAME column in the SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT_PARAMETERS table.


    
        
            Name

            Description

            Naming Convention
        

        
            Service URL parameter

            Defines the URL for the web service call

            <Method>ServiceURL where <Method> is the Http method (GET, POST, DELETE, etc.).
        

        
            Pull parameter value from detail pane model

            Any value from the detail pane model can be passed as an  argument to the web service call

            <ParameterType>_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST) and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Detail Pane Model topic for more information.
        

        
            Pull parameter value from grid column

            Any column from the selected grid row can be passed as an  argument to the web service call

            <ParameterType>_Grid_<ControlName>_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST), <ControlName> is the name of the grid control, and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Grid topic for more information.
        

        
            Pull parameter value from input prompt

            User input via a Modal Dialog prompt can be passed as an argument to the web service call

            <ParameterType>_Input_<ControlName>_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST), <ControlName> is the name of the input control, and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from an Input Control topic for more information.
        

        
            Pull parameter value from javascript function

            The return value from a javascript function can be passed as an argument to the web service call

            <ParameterType>_Function_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST) and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from a JavaScript Function Call topic for more information.
        

        
            Override success callback function

            The default success callback when the web service completes can be overridden

            <Method>_SuccessCallback where <Method> is the Http method (GET, POST, DELETE, etc.). Please reference the How to: Override the Default Success Callback topic for more information.
        

        
            Enable/Disable actions

            Enable or disable an action based on the data in the selected grid record

            EnableAction_<ControlName> where <ControlName> is the name of the control tied to the action.
        
    





            
            See Also
How to: Create Screen Control Event Parameters

 > Metadata Web Pages
 > Shared
 > Screen Control Event Parameter Naming Conventions




    
    
    

        
Event parameters have naming conventions that must be followed in order to dynamically call web services through actions. The following conventions refer to the PARAMETER_NAME column in the SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT_PARAMETERS table.




    

        

            
Name


            
Description


            
Naming Convention

        


        

            
Service URL parameter


            
Defines the URL for the web service call


            
<Method>ServiceURL where <Method> is the Http method (GET, POST, DELETE, etc.).

        


        

            
Pull parameter value from detail pane model


            
Any value from the detail pane model can be passed as an  argument to the web service call


            
<ParameterType>_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST) and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Detail Pane Model topic for more information.

        


        

            
Pull parameter value from grid column


            
Any column from the selected grid row can be passed as an  argument to the web service call


            
<ParameterType>_Grid_<ControlName>_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST), <ControlName> is the name of the grid control, and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from the Insight Grid topic for more information.

        


        

            
Pull parameter value from input prompt


            
User input via a Modal Dialog prompt can be passed as an argument to the web service call


            
<ParameterType>_Input_<ControlName>_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST), <ControlName> is the name of the input control, and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from an Input Control topic for more information.

        


        

            
Pull parameter value from javascript function


            
The return value from a javascript function can be passed as an argument to the web service call


            
<ParameterType>_Function_<InputParameterName> where <ParameterType> is the type of parameter (queryParameter for GET and DELETE and PostData for POST) and <InputParameterName> is the name of the parameter to pass. Please reference the How to: Retrieve Parameter Values from a JavaScript Function Call topic for more information.

        


        

            
Override success callback function


            
The default success callback when the web service completes can be overridden


            
<Method>_SuccessCallback where <Method> is the Http method (GET, POST, DELETE, etc.). Please reference the How to: Override the Default Success Callback topic for more information.

        


        

            
Enable/Disable actions


            
Enable or disable an action based on the data in the selected grid record


            
EnableAction_<ControlName> where <ControlName> is the name of the control tied to the action.

        

    













            
            
See Also
